# OUTPUT DISPLAY

List the open output documents.

## Syntax

```text
OUTPUT DISPLAY.
```

One row per document with its number of tables; the designated one is marked.

## Example

```text
OUTPUT DISPLAY.
```

`statscraft help OUTPUT DISPLAY` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
